reference: Traffic-signal export row labels (VRS5000; local CET = UTC+1; Timestamp column = label - 3600 s). Not validated against true UTC.
time_variable: t = reference (signal-clock) epoch seconds in every formula
sign_convention: offset_X = T_X - T_ref for the same physical event; T_X = T_ref + offset_X; T_ref = T_X - offset_X

signal_row_convention.effect: A row labelled s may describe the instant s, the preceding second (s-1, s] or the following second [s, s+1). Event-based offsets measured against row labels (lamp edges, detector edges) are therefore uncertain by up to 1 s. For the SCU3K2 lamp offsets the true clock offset lies in [offset, offset + 1 s] if rows describe the preceding second, and equals the offset if signal changes occur exactly at row labels.

precision_summary.scu3k2_corrected_vs_signals: approx. +-1 s (statistical +-0.03 s; row convention one-sided [0,+1] s; extrapolation envelope per window)

newsense.evidence: Detector loops D3_2/D4_1: presence-occupancy r=0.857/0.858 at lag 0.0 s; rising-edge cluster (-0.9,+0.2] s whose interpretation depends on the row convention (offset ~ +0.1..+0.2 s or ~ -0.9 s) plus cell geometry ~+-0.3 s; zone-crossing lags +3.4..+4.8 s = physical delay. Bound corrected from +-0.5 s (v1) to +-1 s.

ouster_logs_and_pcap_host.evidence: 2 loops, 28-35 matched edges, medians -0.17/-0.37 s, p05-p95 -2.4..+1.5 s; Newsense activity xcorr -0.50..+0.65 s; log frame phase = PCAP frame-start phase within 1-2 ms (same clock domain, strong hypothesis). Bound corrected from +-1 s (v1) to +-1.5 s.

miovision_SCU3K2_overlay.lamp_identity: K1 (vehicle head): lamp shows red+amber (state S) before green and amber ending exactly 3.0 s after green; only K1 has S and a 3-row amber (F12-F15: G/R only; R1: 2-row amber). On/off-consistent alternatives F12-F15 (1 s shifted) are excluded physically, not only statistically.
miovision_SCU3K2_overlay.estimator: Same rule for all hours/days (v2): pooled median of lamp-edge differences over >= 2 agreeing edge types (ON, OFF_G = green->amber, OFF_A = amber->red), each with >= 8 tight matches and IQR <= 0.10 s. v1 used on+off mean on 29 Oct and off-only on 28 Oct (difference <= 0.02 s).

drift.overlay_vs_mp4_frame_clock_ppm: -11.6 to -12.2 (all 15 mapped camera parts: 14 parts of 29 Oct (7 per camera) + SCU3K2 28 Oct .002)
drift.linearity: Supported only within 29 Oct 06:00-08:00 (two consecutive hours) and by the day-to-day change; NOT measured after 08:00 (lamp contrast too low). The 3-point fit spans a device reboot (system clock re-set from RTC ~05:58 CET daily).

model.inverse: T_overlay = T_ref + offset(T_ref);  T_ref = T_overlay - offset(T_overlay - offset) (one fixed-point step; error < 1 ms)

extrapolation.envelope: |t - nearest measured interval| x 13.3 ppm (within-day drift anywhere between 0 and 2x the fitted slope)
extrapolation.note: Hour 08:00-09:00 gives a single valid edge type (OFF_G, 9 edges) at -51.175 s, ~0.09 s above the model (-51.26); not accepted as a measurement (rule needs 2 agreeing types) but recorded as an unresolved hint of non-linearity.

miovision_SCU3K2_overlay.video_mapping: v2/b6_video_ticks_v2.json: overlay_epoch(pts) = overlay_at_pts0_epoch + pts / pts_s_per_overlay_s for all 15 camera parts (all 14 parts of 29 Oct, both cameras, + SCU3K2 28 Oct .002) and the 3 clips; 50 overlay reads (18 anchors, 32 checks), all checks consistent

miovision_SCU4YV_overlay.evidence: Single shared vehicle (green tanker, identified by livery only) seen moving in SCU4YV at overlay 07:34:09-12; Newsense tracks the truck moving only from 07:35:23.4 (track 2163, ends while still moving at 07:35:35.4; 50 s untracked before). No camera geometry, no lamp.
miovision_SCU4YV_overlay.not_used: Motion-energy correlation (-80.5 s) is NOT used as corroboration: the same method was biased by 3.5 s on SCU3K2.
miovision_SCU4YV_overlay.relation_to_SCU3K2: Not synchronised with SCU3K2 [HYPOTHESIS, not fact]: synchronisation is disfavoured (would place the moving sighting in a period when Newsense shows the truck queued) but not excluded (truck identity unconfirmed).
